period_note: Half-Yearly (Jan-Jun) filing used as the Q2 data point per project convention. Standalone (solo) basis — same document structure as 2019_Q1: Condensed CONSOLIDATED Balance Sheet/P&L/Statement of Changes in Equity/Cash Flow (pp.2-6) followed by the bank's own Condensed [Solo] Balance Sheet/P&L/Statement of Changes in Equity/Cash Flow, captioned without 'Consolidated' (pp.7-11) — Solo used per project convention, matching this bank's 2012-2016 and 2021-2025 solo series. Consolidated total assets (383,190,228,489) vs Solo (339,741,034,678) differ by ~43,449m, the bKash/subsidiary effect. Balance sheet identity reconciles exactly: 339,741,034,678 = 305,524,970,795 (total liabilities) + 34,216,063,883 (total equity). Paid-up capital jumped from 10,725,002,850 (as at Mar-2019/Dec-2018) to 12,333,753,270 as of this filing — the Solo Statement of Changes in Equity (p.10) shows a 1,608,750,420 'Stock dividend' credited to paid-up capital under 'Dividends for the year 2018', i.e. a ~15% bonus share issue distributed during H1 2019; weighted-average shares outstanding rose correspondingly from 1,072,500,285 (Q1) to 1,233,375,327 (this filing), and both this period's and the prior-year comparative period's EPS/NAV-per-share figures have been restated for the bonus issue per IAS 33 (explicit note in source, sections 2.7/3.1/4.1-4.2) — this is a share-count effect, not a restatement of underlying reported profit or equity. Income-statement items below use the Cumulative Jan-to-June 2019 column (the filing also separately discloses a discrete 'Quarter ended April to June 2019' column: interest income 7,385,632,066; PAT 1,296,956,366; EPS 1.05 — not recorded as line items here, per this dataset's Q2 cumulative-only convention). P&L reconciles exactly to the taka at every cumulative subtotal: 10,505,286,623 (total operating income) minus 5,586,554,605 (opex) = 4,918,732,019 (profit before provisions), minus 645,340,206 (total provision) = 4,273,391,813 (profit before tax), minus 1,709,365,545 (tax) = 2,564,026,268 (net profit after tax). No associates line in the solo P&L, so 'Profit/(loss) before provisions' is recorded once under operating_profit_cumulative (same convention as 2019_Q1). Dec-2018 solo comparative (total assets 315,416,675,274; total equity 31,637,951,839) is identical to the value shown in the 2019_Q1 filing — no restatement observed. Small equity sub-reserves are not itemized separately (see 2019_Q1 period_note); total_equity is the full reported total inclusive of them. Off-balance-sheet exposures, CRAR, ROE, ROA and AD ratio taken from Solo-basis disclosures (p.8 off-balance-sheet total and NAV; p.13 'Key Financial Indicators (Standalone basis)' and 'Key Financial Ratios (Solo basis)'); ROE/ROA are the source's own annualized figures. Source PDF is a scanned image with no text layer (pdftotext extracts 0 lines) — figures read visually from 150dpi page renders.
